whatAuthorizationMeans: Execute is authorized against an EXACT reviewed implementation tree, not against a branch. Setting status to EXECUTE_AUTHORIZED without naming the reviewed SHA authorizes nothing, and the gate rejects it.

howTheGateWorks.enforcedBy: scripts/eval/lib/issue-149-execute-authorization.ts, driven by scripts/eval/issue-149-execute-gate.mjs in the workflow
howTheGateWorks.whyNotThePathsFilter: GitHub's paths: filter decides WHETHER the workflow runs when a push touches a matching file. It places no restriction on what else that push contains. A commit could change workflow-mode.txt AND the runner, adapter, a contract or a bundle input and still trigger execute, with the changed code never reviewed. The changed-file restriction is therefore enforced against the actual commit range.
conditions: the artifact names an exact 40-character reviewed implementation SHA
the current head descends from that SHA
every path changed since that SHA is one of the permitted transition files
the mode file contains exactly the bytes "execute\n"

currentDecision: Execute is NOT authorized. This sprint implements the dormant execute path and re-runs discovery; execute requires a later, explicit authorization decision.
